- **Test image**: Banana fruits. Leftmost banana has extensive dark brown/black lesions covering most of the peel; adjacent bananas have scattered brown spots. This is a fruit-level disease.

- **Anthracnose** (PlantWild_1.jpg): Shows banana fruits with dark brown/black spots on the peel that coalesce — closely matches the test image pattern and fruit context.

- **Cigar_End_Rot**: Black necrosis only at the fruit tip — doesn't match (test image has full-peel coverage).

- **Panama_Disease**: Affects leaves with yellowing/browning — not fruit.

- **Cordana_Leaf_Spot**: Oval lesions on leaves — not fruit.

The test image clearly shows fruit-surface dark lesions characteristic of Anthracnose (Colletotrichum musae), where spots coalesce into large black areas on the peel.
